points.text: An Israeli airstrike in southern Gaza killed Samir Abu Younis, a senior Hamas commander whom Hamas said helped plan the October 7, 2023, attack on Israel.
Iran said it attacked a US military installation in Bahrain with drones, while Bahrain said it intercepted and destroyed several aerial attacks.
A UPS cargo plane and a Copa Airlines passenger jet collided while taxiing at Miami International Airport; reports differed on whether anyone was injured.
A Jordanian court sentenced three men to death for a church attack in Karak that killed nine people and wounded 25, according to reports.
Nearly 2,200 migrants reached Spain’s Canary Islands over two days, with many arriving from West African countries, Spanish authorities and reports said.
